notes: REF-BM-02: fetchPageInfo collects only title+description; no favicon or preview image (client shows a generated letter icon). REF-BM-04: sanitizePatch allows title/description/note/tags but not url; url cannot be edited. REF-BM-14: search is plain substring over a haystack that stores tags without '#', so '#tag' syntax does not match. REF-BM-15: matchesSearch only requires all whitespace-separated words (implicit AND); no OR/NOT/parentheses/quoting. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact match; quotes treated as literal chars. REF-BM-20: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-21: no bulk-to-filter action. REF-BM-22: list always sorted by savedAt desc; no sort-key selection (title, etc.). REF-BM-23: note is stored/displayed but rendered as plain text, not markdown. REF-BM-24..25: no snapshot/PDF/Internet Archive feature. REF-BM-26..28: no archive concept (hide/reversible/archived list). REF-BM-29: no bundles. REF-BM-30..31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: no user display settings (sort/items/font size).
